title: HR Assistant
description:
HR Assistant

We are working exclusively with a well-known, European leading organisation on the lookout for a HR Assistant to join their team in Warwick. This is an incredible opportunity to join a great company within a fantastic team.

This role will be responsible for managing the administration for the whole employee life cycle, for all employees split over two business units. Providing a proactive and efficient HR administrative service that supports the overall objectives of the department. Acting as the point of contact for all first level HR issues, ensuring correct procedures are followed; documented where applicable and excellent service is provided to all stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:
- To be the first point of contact for all HR queries - providing guidance and support to managers and/or employees in line with company policies and procedures and statutory provisions
- Maintaining an efficient and effective new starter process from point of offer through to onboarding, ensuring that the set HR procedure is followed and all associated electronic and paper based information is inputted in a timely manner
- Maintain all updates on the HR management systems (SAP; Success Factors and Umantis) and all other internal HR systems)
- Ensuring a strong link is maintained between HR and Payroll and all associated documentation is submitted with accuracy and on time
- Providing a general administrative service for the HR department, including but not limited to:
- Generating letters, contracts and ensuring statutory process adherence
- Updating KPI information and generating ad hoc statistical reporting
- Respond to external and internal information requests
- Supporting projects and completion of HR objectives
- Assisting with the recruitment process, from applicant tracking through to assisting with first level assessments
- Processing invoices & monitoring departmental budgetary spend
- Conducting exit interviews
- General office duties such as the upkeep of personnel records and maintaining the H.R filing and archive system, standards forms and compliance with GDPR
- Provide support with the facilitation of training source and arrange course enrolment, gather information to produce training agreements and maintain records of training undertaken.
- Provide advice and guidance to managers, supporting on first level employee relations issues
- Managing and supporting the recruitment process including administration and first level assessment support
- Undertake projects as and when required in line with the objectives of the role

KEY REQUIREMENTS
- Previous administration experience in a fast-paced commercial business
- Dealing with confidential subject matter
- Experience working with SAP
- Knowledge and ability to offer first line HR advice in relation to current legislation
- Experience working with multiple stakeholders and competing deadlines
- Managed a high level of recruitment activity
- First level HR advice, e.g. performance issues, ER, coaching
- HR Degree (or equivalent HR qualification)
- Confidence to deal with people internally and externally at all levels
- Ability to use own initiative and learn quickly
- Ability to prioritise own work levels

By applying for this position, you authorise Auctoro Recruitment to hold your personal details on file for use in finding you a suitable position. Auctoro Recruitment will never transfer your information to a third party without your prior consent.

title: HR Officer
description:
HR Officer
Location: Warwick
Salary: £38,000-£40,000 per annum, depending on experience
Contract: Three-month temp-to-perm, transferring to direct employment with our client following successful completion

Looking for a hands-on HR role where you can help shape how a growing business supports its people?
Recruitable Staffing Solutions is recruiting an experienced HR Officer for our client based in Warwick.
This varied generalist position combines day-to-day HR support with the opportunity to improve policies, processes and ways of working. You'll work closely with management, helping build fair, consistent and practical HR practices as the business grows.

The role
Your responsibilities will include:
- Coordinating recruitment, onboarding and leaver processes.
- Providing first-line HR support to employees and management.
- Reviewing existing HR practices, identifying gaps and recommending improvements.
- Drafting and updating HR policies and procedures for management approval.
- Maintaining accurate, confidential employee records.
- Managing absence and attendance records, checking routine timesheets and preparing payroll information for an external provider.
- Supporting HR planning, budgets and reporting.
- Implementing agreed HR initiatives and monitoring their progress.
- Escalating sensitive matters or significant decisions to management when appropriate.

About you
We're looking for someone with:
- Previous experience in a UK-based generalist HR or HR Officer role, ideally around three to five years.
- Practical knowledge of UK employment rights and day-to-day HR processes.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- A confident, approachable communication style.
- The ability to handle sensitive information professionally and confidentially.
- A proactive approach, with the judgement to recognise when management approval or specialist advice is needed.

You don't need experience in every responsibility listed. A strong grounding in generalist HR and the ability to take ownership of day-to-day processes are key.

What's on offer?
- £38,000-£40,000 annual salary, depending on experience.
- An initial three-month temporary assignment through Recruitable Staffing Solutions, with the intention of transferring to permanent employment directly with our client following successful completion.
- A varied role with scope to make a visible contribution.
- The opportunity to help develop HR processes within a growing business.

Apply with your up-to-date CV, outlining your relevant HR experience and availability.

title: Recruitment Partner
description:
Vectis Recruitment is a trusted partner to companies operating in the Aerospace, Automotive, Industrial and High Technology Sectors. Due to continued growth and long-term client partnerships we have a new vacancy for a Recruitment Partner to join our team. You will play a key role in developing long term relationships with clients and identifying and attracting high-quality candidates.

The Role

Work closely with clients and develop long term relationships.

Source candidates using job boards, LinkedIn, networking and internal databases.

Screen CVs and conduct telephone, video and face to face interviews.

Build and maintain talent pipelines for current and future vacancies.

Write and post engaging job advertisements across multiple platforms.

Arrange interviews and coordinate candidate communications.

Provide an excellent candidate experience throughout the recruitment process.

Monitor market trends and identify new sourcing strategies.

The Person

Previous experience in recruitment, sales or customer service is preferred but not essential.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

A proactive, positive, and resilient attitude.

Excellent attention to detail.
